WITH album_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    AlbumId,
    AVG(UnitPrice) as avg_unit_price,
    AVG(CASE WHEN Bytes IS NOT NULL AND Milliseconds IS NOT NULL 
             THEN CAST(Bytes AS DECIMAL(15,5)) / Milliseconds 
             ELSE NULL END) as bytes_per_ms
  FROM Track
  GROUP BY AlbumId
),
overall_avg_rate AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(CASE WHEN Bytes IS NOT NULL AND Milliseconds IS NOT NULL 
             THEN CAST(Bytes AS DECIMAL(15,5)) / Milliseconds 
             ELSE NULL END) as avg_bytes_per_ms
  FROM Track
)
SELECT 
  a.AlbumId,
  a.avg_unit_price,
  a.bytes_per_ms,
  a.bytes_per_ms - o.avg_bytes_per_ms as difference
FROM album_stats a
CROSS JOIN overall_avg_rate o
WHERE a.bytes_per_ms IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10
